column1: # Tests expected to fail in strict mode (./run.sh), one per line: name<TAB>category<TAB>reason.
# Categories: kit = the kit expects something the spec doesn't require or that no IdP can do;
# spec = localsaml deviates from the specification.
# The kit's lenient mode (LENIENT=1 ./run.sh) only accepts error pages with an HTTP error code,
# which Bindings 3.4.6/3.5.6 forbid, so it fails the same tests.

column3: An AuthnRequest with no ID, Version or Issuer has no service provider or ACS to send an error Response to, so localsaml shows an error page, with HTTP 200 because Bindings 3.5.6 says SAML failures MUST NOT use HTTP error codes. The kit wants either a SAML error Response (impossible without an ACS) or, in lenient mode, an HTTP error code (forbidden).
As above, for the Redirect binding (Bindings 3.4.6).

column1: Bindings 3.4.3: Redirect Incomplete AuthnRequest In URL Query Test
column3: A truncated SAMLRequest can't be decoded, so there's no service provider or ACS to answer; localsaml shows an error page with HTTP 200 (Bindings 3.4.6), which the kit doesn't accept.
